content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: each Save click on purchase order:new is followed by a coverage overlay that stays shown for about 6 s (shown at 12785 ms, removed at 18803 ms; shown at 16125 ms, removed at 22142 ms), and users click Save again while or just before it clears, with no state change in the events.", "fix": "Fix: on the purchase order:new screen, disable the Save button from its click until the save response returns and the overlay is removed, and show an inline saving indicator on that button so repeat clicks are not needed.", "cited_event_ids": ["422", "424", "426:w461", "429", "430:x472", "421", "423", "425:w482", "428", "429:x490"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The overlay is not labelled, so its purpose (save progress or something else) cannot be confirmed from the events.", "The events do not show whether the Save request succeeded, failed or created a document, so the outcome is not verified.", "The windows show no visible state change text, so the no-feedback claim rests on the insight facts rather than on event content.", "The cause of the roughly 6 s overlay duration is not visible in the events."]}
